card.name: Verbs and nouns after a determiner
card.fires_on: Ordinary words that come right after 'the', 'this', 'their' or a similar determiner or noun phrase, often a passive verb or noun like 'administered', 'built', 'seat' or 'profits'. It is a general mix of web and label text.

modes.label: Passive verb after a subject
modes.description: A verb such as administered or built that follows a noun and is expected to be followed by a time or place phrase.

modes.label: Noun after 'the' or 'this'
modes.description: A common noun or determiner in the middle of a clause, before the sentence continues.
modes.example: Turn in<< this>> assignment as a hardcopy printout.

card.plain: It fires on everyday words in the middle of a sentence, such as a verb or noun after 'the' or 'this', with no single theme.
